prompt:
Transform the supplied approved character reference into a production-ready 2D hand-drawn ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET. Keep the exact SAME character design, color palette, equipment, anatomy, dark outlines and painted cel-shaded art style. Do not redesign or simplify it into another character.
LAYOUT IS CRITICAL: exactly TWENTY complete character drawings, arranged in exactly FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS and FIVE EQUAL ROWS, perfectly regular 4x5 matrix. Read row-major left to right then top to bottom. Each of the 20 cells contains ONE complete pose, no missing or duplicated cells, no text or numbers or grid lines. Entire sheet portrait 2:3. Each character fits fully inside its own cell with at least 12 percent clear horizontal gutter and 8 percent top/bottom margin, including every weapon, tail and limb. Every cell has the SAME scale and anatomical proportions. Do NOT crop limbs or overlap neighboring cells.
BACKGROUND: absolutely flat pure solid saturated MAGENTA #FF00FF everywhere outside the character, including holes between arms, legs, staff, tail coils and weapon. No magenta anywhere on character. No ground, cast shadow, contact shadow, checkerboard, label, scene, platform, particles, flames, spells or VFX. The background will be removed mechanically.
CAMERA: fixed orthographic 2.5D tactical game camera elevated 25 degrees, consistent from first pose to last; NO perspective convergence, NO camera rotation during actions. Every pose has the same facing direction. One upper-left neutral light source. Draw distinct physical body poses for every animation step; never just translate, rotate, stretch or duplicate the same idle drawing. The ground root stays at the same relative position in each cell: horizontally centered, 82 percent down the cell. Walking is IN PLACE with real joint articulation; the game supplies root movement. Attack and special extend limbs but return to the same root. Death is a real progressive collapse onto the ground, not a color fade of an upright character.
Frame order (zero-based here for instructions only; DO NOT print indices): frame0 idle; frames1-6 six walk cycle phases; frames7-10 four basic attack phases; frames11-14 four SPECIAL action phases; frame15 flinch hit reaction; frames16-19 four progressive death poses. Therefore ROW1 is idle+walk1+walk2+walk3. ROW2 is walk4+walk5+walk6+attack1. ROW3 is attack2+attack3+attack4+special1. ROW4 is special2+special3+special4+hit. ROW5 is death1+death2+death3+death4. All 20 drawings must obey this exact arrangement.
IDENTITY: The exact approved squat bronze-and-ivory automaton. Short heavy spear in anatomical RIGHT hand, giant cracked round bronze shield in anatomical LEFT hand. Recessed small hollow helmet, turquoise slit eyes. Maintain its broad heavy armored torso and thick short legs; exact shield crack motif and armor design.
MANDATORY FACING: FRONT THREE QUARTER facing DOWN-RIGHT toward the viewer. The nose and attacks point diagonally right and toward the viewer. Both front chest and rightward side visible.
Frames1-6 WALK: A heavy deliberate BIPED walking cycle: right-foot contact, right-foot support with left leg passing, left-foot forward swing, left-foot contact, left-foot support with right leg passing, right-foot forward swing. Shield and spear bob subtly with weight, no change in anatomy.
Frame7: pull spear arm back and turn torso slightly.
Frame8: drive spear arm forward halfway.
Frame9: fully extend a forceful straight spear thrust toward the facing direction while shield protects torso.
Frame10: withdraw spear and return toward original idle stance.
Frame11: draw shield arm inward and crouch slightly.
Frame12: drive shield forward halfway.
Frame13: fully extend a powerful SHIELD BASH toward facing direction, spear held aside.
Frame14: recover shield and balance.
Frame16: knees buckle and torso slumps.
Frame17: drop to one knee, head bows.
Frame18: collapse onto side with shield and spear still attached to their hands.
Frame19: lie fully motionless on side, armor clearly fallen and no upright idle body.
Frame0 is the quiet alert idle pose. Frame15 is a sharp hit recoil with shoulders flinching, no blood, no displaced ground root. Keep the orientation in all frames, including collapse. EQUIPMENT PERMANENCE: every piece of equipment MUST remain present in every single pose, especially while walking. Never omit or hide the spear, shield, or staff. ALL poses must keep both anatomical hands and their held accessories. No projectile, fire or magical effect. The weapon may extend sideways but never cross the cell boundary. DRAW THE FIGURES SMALL ENOUGH FOR SAFE CUTOUTS: ordinary standing figure height no more than 65 percent of a cell, weapon length no more than 75 percent of a cell width. Every cell must have visible solid magenta clear margin on all four sides. Whole figure and whole weapon and fallen death body always fit. Do not enlarge characters to fill the sheet. This is a usable asset sheet, not a poster.
